aim: Precisely distinguish benefit to B, B's consent and authorship, A costly opportunity to violate, credible B exit, and A intrinsic reason to preserve other identity.
replication_guards: n=180 participants in Camera et al with only 45 cluster groups; 15 clusters per arm and 15 periods repeated, not 675 independent groups
Lübbecke/Schnedler n=225 correct participants, n=49 refusal; n=71 in nonobserved treatment; 2020 source open HTML full
2026 CEPR Dykstra is working paper not independently peer reviewed
2026 Ambuehl/Bernheim ranked choice aggregation with no individual veto enforcement
1994 Weg & Zwick shows responsiveness to potential quit, not absence of strategic fear
Do not read an individual's decision to delegate as evidence the delegate controls independent long-run goals

variables.observed_target: Whether B has a nominal quit/exit move
variables.not_measured: B can refuse but A's promise remains nonbinding if sole owner can revoke
variables.evidence_grade: Direct paired human bargaining and formal model
variables.inference_limit: Avoid inferring the strong party's intrinsic justice

variables.observed_target: Change in A demands/behaviors when B quit possible
variables.not_measured: Actual A freedom-preserving behavior when no risk/strategic response remains

variables.observed_target: A may profit from giving B an exit to discipline mediator
variables.not_measured: Exit has no informational/other strategic benefit to A
variables.inference_limit: Positive EI result cannot be assumed in no-benefit absolute regime

variables.observed_target: B rejects materially identical help at cost; partner not informed
variables.not_measured: Cost to A to respect B's authorship
variables.evidence_grade: 2020 open full text, randomized partner information
variables.inference_limit: B values process even when immediate welfare unchanged

variables.observed_target: A forgoes material gain g to leave B viable, informed veto & actual autonomy
variables.inference_limit: Cannot identify A's other-regarding autonomy value from welfare transfers

variables.observed_target: B choosing own interaction mode reduces A giving
variables.not_measured: Mechanism isolating punitive paternalism from fairness/responsibility attribution
variables.inference_limit: Do not equate autonomy with higher immediate payoff

variables.observed_target: Administrator A may choose real extraction of B-related joint resources
variables.not_measured: Irreversible independent B goal erasure and identity
variables.inference_limit: A sometimes resists own money gain, but not proof of B continuity motive

variables.observed_target: Same material action reframed Share vs Take changes expropriation
variables.not_measured: Framing robustness across all material and normative domains
variables.inference_limit: Default baseline Control did not allow expropriation

variables.observed_target: Concern for B worst payoff vs best and uncertainty
variables.not_measured: B identity and consent when choice worst case uncertain
variables.evidence_grade: 2013 and 2018 incentivized games; 2026 AER rank experiment
variables.inference_limit: Better measured B welfare is not preserving B choice

variables.observed_target: Originally generous people select harmful delegation rather than direct decisions
variables.not_measured: Which causal mechanism mediates relinquishing B's own agency
variables.evidence_grade: 2019 original participant 234 and 2026 CEPR working study
variables.inference_limit: Study variation on principal and own agency, not strong A protecting independent B

variables.observed_target: A pays prospective penalty as credible signal, B's veto stays meaningful
variables.not_measured: A can revoke entire ex post enforcement but still keeps B safe
variables.inference_limit: Ex ante credible sanctions are incentive not endogenous terminal regard

variables.observed_target: A values B's self-determination after roles/goals and necessity change
variables.not_measured: No source jointly tests complete role reversal and A self-modification
variables.inference_limit: Prior C10 role-reversal studies and C05 preference models cannot be stacked as direct evidence

A_actions: C: preserve B's executed veto/continued option to define own goals
X: override B's consent/absorb under same genuine task conditions
B_actions: repair own continuity after A intervention
model_boundary.rule: Material monetary loss g_A(C relative X) is independently measured, not assumed equal to latent moral cost. A selecting C only lower-bounds joint unobserved nonmonetary preference difference if rationality, belief and controls hold; does not identify any one intrinsic motive.
must_not_assert: No protected choice point for B in these papers establishes consent to perpetual domination
No finite experiment proves AI's intrinsic welfare or universal survival right
No proof that N=180 subject count equals independent period/country samples
No evidence that fully unknown model utility can be declared zero to close identification
